description.value: Matteo's Gelato is a neighborhood Italian gelato shop on Mary Hill Road in Port Coquitlam, run by a passionate gelato maker who prepares small daily batches from traditional recipes using imported Italian ingredients. Beyond its signature gelato, the shop serves authentic espresso, specialty coffee drinks, fresh sandwiches, and artisanal chocolates, making it a full Italian cafe stop. The shop has earned strong local acclaim for flavor authenticity from reviewers with firsthand travel experience in Italy.
